messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- INC-2025-023 was an incident involving the indexer on 2025-10-24. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- A silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The indexer belongs to the Boreal team as of 2025-02-28. [decision; valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer]
    earlier: Cinder owns the indexer as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-02-28; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Boreal reported at standup on 2026-02-04 that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- The indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, as agreed on 2025-11-07. [decision; valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-07]
- Boreal handed billing-api to Team Dune on 2026-03-25. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Boreal announced at standup on 2026-03-13 a deploy freeze for Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-13]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- INC-2025-004 was caused by a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-03-06 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The scheduler is not a Boreal service; Boreal flagged the scheduler at standup on 2026-02-04. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- Lena picked up the Boreal on-call pager from Marcus Oyelaran on 2025-08-12. [decision; valid 2025-08-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-12]
- Team Atlas observed on 2025-11-11 that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- The webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-08 during INC-2026-003. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Boreal handed the event bus to Team Dune on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-event-bus]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]

Question: On what date was the review of INC-2025-023 written?
